title: War Department asks FBI to clear GeBauer

tellings.quote: the War Department is asking the FBI to clear him. So, I think he worked on some kind of topshelf project.

plain: In 1942 or 1943, the War Department asked J. Edgar Hoover's FBI to give a security clearance to a man named Leo GeBauer, according to Scott Ramsey, a researcher who has studied a reported 1948 UFO crash near Aztec, New Mexico. Ramsey tells Michels he found this in GeBauer's FBI file, and from it he reasons, in his words, "I think he worked on some kind of topshelf project," though he does not say the file names any project. It matters to him because it would mean GeBauer had serious secret government work behind him.
